name: NBA props model
distribution: negative binomial, variance A x mean^B (params.var); P(over a line) = P(stat >= floor(line) + 1); double- and triple-double by a one-factor Gaussian copula (params.rho)

fair.main: whole margin on the Over: fair Over = 1 - implied(Under), fair Under = implied(Under)
fair.mainWhy: scored best of eight methods on the 11,395 archived closing lines graded (log loss 0.6788, multiplicative 0.6807; Overs hit 45.9% where an even split said 49.0%)

rung.form: fair = implied - a between 30% and 70%, scaled toward 0 below 30% (implied x (1 - a/0.3)) and toward 1 above 70% (1 - (1 - implied) x (1 + a/0.3))
rung.measured: the "k+" rung at line + 0.5 against the main line's fair Over: 8,055 archived rungs, a median gap of 6.8 points (6.1 on points) in every price band from 30% to 70%; 6.8 again on opening night's 146

yes.measured: calibrated on the archived playoff prices' results: 1,027 double-double prices (11.9% happened where their prices said 16.8%) and 328 triple-double prices (5 happened: very thin)

fair.estimated: every fair chance but the main line's is an estimate from these measurements: mark it est.

folds.role: development: the structure was chosen on this fold
